proofs.name: Source identity, positive-q domain and complete finite prefix
proofs.proof: The live factory recursively authenticates the original forced/current/representative/band/common-family chain. The original domain is T>=0, q=Q_ref*s>0, 1/2<=s<=2, 0<q<qGlobalStar=2^(-(ell0+4)), and b_(N+1)*q>=1 (N=1 here). Monotonic b_n makes every omitted cutoff and its derivatives zero. Every active label has ell>=ell0. The selected representative is in the same box, at distance<4/S^3. This is a source-defined finite-prefix window, not all q for N=1. The explicit selector growth ensures such windows exist.

proofs.name: Positive chart, cylindrical and frame denominators
proofs.proof: Q=2^-ell, epsilon=Q^h and s in[1/2,2] are positive; k=ceil(epsilon^-1/2)>=1. Active local bodies have Xa<X<Xb, Xa>0 and R=sqrt(2sX)>0. Fixed radial integrals use sqrt(Xa)<=R<=2sqrt(Xb). The monotone chart derivative is 1-2h*eta^2>=1-2h>1/2. Palette scale ci=Tg^i*Q^(1+h)>0, Tg=4+sqrt(2)>0 and Dgeom=4-2sqrt(2)>0. Original same-box/frame bounds protect tangential/full normal denominators. Cylindrical quotients are evaluated on R>0; the receipt does not evaluate raw 1/R at the axis.

proofs.name: Actual fixed H and original positive primary amplitudes
proofs.proof: The common-family threshold is a representative-independent maximum of the original cone, concentration and frame conditions; active ell>=ell0 satisfies them. The retained source argument gives |det H|>=d*/S with d*>0 and y_sigma>=c*zeta>0 on the open stress shell. H and a_sigma=sqrt(y_sigma) are the actual same-band Volterra/Haar fields. The signed update checks that they equal the old original H columns and amplitudes and divides by epsilon*det H*2a. It does not take a square root of signed Sigma. At flat shell endpoints, the original smooth zero extension and lazy support guard apply; no strictly positive endpoint lower bound for a is asserted.

proofs.name: Normalized bump and compact Sigma inverse
proofs.proof: x0=sqrt(2X0Imean)*exp(1/2)>0 and sqrt(s)>0. The seed exp(-1/(u(1-u))) is strictly positive on 0<u<1 and has smooth zero extension. Its full support lies in the original Imean patch inside the fixed radial envelope, so rhoMass>0 and integral rho=1. For e=1,2, actual M=integral R^e Haar(E) obeys integral R^e[Haar(E)-rho*R^-e*M]=0. Thus the radial primitive has the original compact-support/FTC meaning. It uses the full current E, not an initial-zero-mean-only identity.

proofs.name: Temporal Fourier divisors and exact limit
proofs.proof: For k=(k0,k1)!=0, m=k1-k0 and n=k0 give k.v_t=m+n*sqrt(2). Its integer norm m^2-2n^2 is nonzero, hence has absolute value>=1. The code checks the exact norm for materialized modes and retains the universal Diophantine bound. Also 2*pi>0 and ci>0. The zero mode is separated. Actual inherited Volterra solutions, smooth guarded joins, products, Haar means and compact translated integrals provide smoothness/periodicity for the new Etheta/Ez. The exact inverse remains the state operand; finite C0/C1 tail checks do not replace it by a finite sum.

proofs.name: Fixed five-profile matrix denominators
proofs.proof: The actual source fixes lambda=exp(-1000*T)>0, a(eta)>0, d=1/5 and a positive nonzero bump in x>0. Every mu_p is strictly positive. Angular powers 2,-2-2lambda,-2lambda are pairwise distinct, so their exp(d*p) nodes have nonzero gaps. Axial e^d>0 and 1-exp(-2*d*lambda)>0. The unchanged source bridge checks support, positive normalized moments, angular determinant separation and the factored axial inverse. Zero in the enclosing lambda interval is only an endpoint, not its actual value. The successor uses the identical matrix/profiles but fresh post-temporal P/J targets. No uniformity as lambda tends to zero or requirement lambda>d is imposed.

proofs.name: Cutoff and exact coefficient-field denominators
proofs.proof: Smooth-step inverse bodies are used only in their open transition intervals; the exponential sum denominator is positive there. Local pulse/mesh bodies are protected by lazy piecewise guards before singular inverses are evaluated. Literal Q(sqrt(2)) coefficient inversion rejects zero norm. Other analytic source expressions remain their actual opaque operands, with no invented algebraic relations. This supplies semantics beyond polynomial numerator cancellation.
